title: Session panel shows only this session's work; project-wide items move to a Project info view

fields.why: TJ is overwhelmed by project-wide items in each session's right panel

text: TJ: the right panel in a session should ALWAYS only show what this session's agent is doing, never project-wide things. Move project-wide items (project goal, rest of the project, backlog, questions for other work, do-not list, completed) to a 'Project info' or 'Project backlog' view opened from a button, e.g. on the dashboard project card. Panel is InspectorView.swift; card is DashboardView.swift. Ask TJ before deciding where each section goes. Do not touch SessionsView.swift or AppModel.swift (tab work in progress). Do not restart the app.
Session panel shows only this session's work: its status, its tasks, the goal its task serves, and only reviews, questions and do-nots about its own tasks or goal
check: eye: open a session panel in a project with other work; no Project goal / Rest of the project / Being worked on / Backlog / Completed cards appear

text: A Project info view shows everything project-wide: current goal, rest of the project, all reviews, all questions, all do-nots, claims, backlog, other goals, completed
check: eye: open Project info for genlock; every project-wide card is there

text: Project info opens from a button on the dashboard project card and from a button at the foot of the session panel
check: eye: click both buttons; each opens Project info for that project

text: A session with no task shows Waiting for work only when nothing suggests untracked work: it has never run a turn, or it ended its last turn after finishing a task; a session that ran a turn without any task shows an amber No task recorded warning with what it last said
check: swift test --filter CoreTests (sessionStatus cases for nil phase, done+lastFinished, done+no history)

text: The app builds and existing tests pass
check: cd app && swift build && swift test

text: Finishing a task (genlock done) and then ending the turn means the turn's work was tracked
breaks: an agent that finishes a task then does untracked work in the same turn shows Waiting for work

evidence: CoreTests sessionStatus: status(nil, blank)=.waitingForWork, status(done, lastFinished)=.waitingForWork 'Last finished: Report families', status(done, blank)=.untracked with said-line detail; swift test 97 tests 0 failures
swift build: Build complete (39.52s); swift test: Executed 97 tests, 0 failures

text: Built: InspectorView split into sessionContent (status, own tasks, own goal, own questions/reviews/do-nots, Project info footer button) and projectContent; ProjectInfoView sheet; info button + context menu on dashboard card; SessionStrip narrowed; new statuses waitingForWork/untracked in Snapshot. Build+97 tests pass. Reqs 1-3 await TJ's eye (no restart by me). Not committed.
